biggest_catch: Reward cards take 4-6 weeks to arrive after the friend completes everything, and auto-loan referrals require a $5,000 minimum funded loan.
catches: Friend must fund a checking account and make 15 non-ATM debit card transactions within 60 days (checking referrals).
Auto-loan referrals require a $5,000+ funded loan within 6 months of referral registration.
Cap: up to $500 per year in reward cards.
Payout is a Mastercard Reward Card, not cash.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Merchants Bank's official page (firstmerchants.com/personal/banking/checking-accounts/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer A Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $50 Mastercard Reward Card for each friend who opens a qualifying checking account or auto loan with the referral link, up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register via the on-page form to get a referral link; share it with friends/family; the friend opens a checking account, funds it, and makes 15 non-ATM debit card transactions within 60 days (checking), or registers, opens, and funds a new auto loan with a $5,000+ minimum balance within 6 months of referral registration (auto loan).

c4.evidence: Timing: allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.

eligibility: First Merchants Bank customers referring friends who open a qualifying checking account or auto loan.
notes: Separate checking and auto-loan referral offers pay the same $50 to the referrer. Distinct from signup bonuses R0067/R0949/R0950.
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of $50.00 Mastercard Reward Card.
payout_quote: Get $50 for you, and $50 for them.
payout_value_note: Mastercard Reward Card (gift card), not cash.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral registration is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: up to $500 per year in reward cards.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: register via the on-page form to get a referral link; share it with friends/family; tell them to check junk mail for the referral email.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: checking — open a qualifying checking account, fund it, and make 15 non-ATM debit card transactions within 60 days; auto loan — register, open, and fund a new auto loan with a $5,000+ minimum balance within 6 months of referral registration.

steps: Register via the form on the First Merchants Bank refer-a-friend page to get your referral link.
Share the link with friends/family (tell them to check their email's junk folder).
Friend opens a qualifying checking account, funds it, and makes 15 non-ATM debit transactions within 60 days (or funds a $5,000+ auto loan within 6 months).
You both earn a $50 Mastercard Reward Card; allow 4-6 weeks for delivery.
timing: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.
when_cash_arrives: Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Reward Card after completing all offer requirements. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
